blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِيْنَ ۞ الّذِيْنَ اِذَا اكْتَالُوْا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُوْنَ ۞ وَاِذَا كَالُوْهُمْ اَوْ وَزَنُوْهُمْ يُخْسِرُوْنَ ۞ اَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولئِكَ اَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوْثُوْنَ ۞ لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۞ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Woe to those who give short (in weight and measure)! They are those who, when they take a measure from people, take it in full, but when they measure out to them or weigh out to them, they give short (and cause loss). Do they not believe for certain that they will be raised (after death)? On a mighty Day, the Day when mankind will stand (out of their graves) before the Rabb of the worlds.
Woe to every one who finds fault and backbites!

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّكَ اِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ عَوْرَاتِ النَّاسِ اَفْسَدْتَهُمْ، أَوْ كِدْتَ اَنْ تُفْسِدَهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في التجسس، رقم:٤٨٨٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'awiyah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “If you go searching for people's faults, you have corrupted them.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- By searching for people's faults, hatred, anger and countless evils arise among them. Moreover, by searching for people's faults and spreading them, those people become emboldened to commit sins. All of these
